# Octopus Agile Dashboard

> A lightweight web app for viewing Octopus Agile electricity prices, tracker prices, and UK grid carbon intensity.

## Site Map

- /: Interactive dashboard showing current Agile prices, tracker prices, historical pricing, and carbon intensity.

## Notes for Language Models

- This is a public, read-only dashboard.
- The app is client-side and fetches live data from external energy APIs in the browser.
- No authentication or account features are exposed on this site.
